title: Are you Talking Logic to Me? Assessing Language Models Syllogistic Reasoning Capabilities
abstract: arXiv:2608.12374v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language models (LMs) struggle with logical tasks like reasoning on syllogisms. It has been shown that Knowledge Representation (KR) plays a crucial role in expressing input information to help models solve tasks. This observation motivates our study of the impact of different formal KR notations on syllogistic reasoning by extending the FOLIO and P-FOLIO datasets. Our experiments on Small Language Models (SLMs) in Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Zero-Shot (ZS) settings show that the choice of input notation can yield performances competitive with natural language while enabling faster inference. We also propose a syllogistic categorization method (SEF) and use it to enrich ZS prompts with logical definitions, which boost reasoning in small models. We open-source our framework, Common Logic Grammar Construction (CLGC), as the first Python library for automatically generating syllogisms in KR notations and defining their SEF categories

translated_title: 你在跟我谈逻辑吗？评估语言模型的三段论推理能力
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12374v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：语言模型（LMs）在诸如三段论推理等逻辑任务上表现不佳。研究表明，知识表示（KR）在表达输入信息以帮助模型解决问题方面起着关键作用。这一观察促使我们通过扩展FOLIO和P-FOLIO数据集，研究不同形式化KR表示对三段论推理的影响。我们在小语言模型（SLMs）上的监督微调（SFT）和零样本（ZS）设置中的实验表明，输入表示的选择可以产生与自然语言相当的性能，同时实现更快的推理。我们还提出了一种三段论分类方法（SEF），并用其丰富零样本提示中的逻辑定义，从而提升小模型的推理能力。我们开源了我们的框架——通用逻辑语法构建器（CLGC），这是第一个用于自动生成KR表示中的三段论并定义其SEF类别的Python库。
tldr: 本研究通过扩展数据集和提出SEF分类方法，证明在零样本提示中加入逻辑定义能显著提升小语言模型的三段论推理性能，并开源了首个自动生成知识表示三段论的Python库CLGC。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that enriching zero-shot prompts with logical definitions via a novel SEF categorization method significantly boosts syllogistic reasoning in small language models, and it open-sources CLGC, the first Python library for automatically generating syllogisms in knowledge representation notations.
